name: ui-ux
description: Product-aware UI/UX Head Skill with mandatory routing for websites, dashboards, web apps, mobile apps, and WordPress plugin UI.

interface.longDescription: Design, audit, improve, and validate production interfaces with mandatory product-type routing. Supports websites, dashboards, web applications, mobile applications, and WordPress plugin/admin UI, with product-specific required packs, local UI/UX rules, and external Persian-language validation when Persian-facing UI is in scope. Includes evidence-driven UX audits, visual regression, design-system architecture, responsive behavior, Light/Dark themes, RTL/LTR, personalization, Data Trust UX, accessibility, performance, and regression-aware QA.
capabilities: Route UI work by product type before design
Design websites and public-facing product sites
Design dashboards and operational data UI
Design WordPress plugin and admin UI
Route Persian-facing UI to required language QA
defaultPrompt: Classify this product, load the required Product Pack, then audit and improve its UI/UX without breaking behavior.
Design this website or web application using the correct product-specific UI/UX rules and validate representative states.
Improve this mobile or WordPress plugin UI using its required Product Pack while preserving constraints.
